mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (conversation_id, buyer_id, seller_id, last_message_at, last_preview, buyer_unread, seller_unread, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{lastMessageAt}, NULL, 0, 0, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE conversation_id = conversation_id
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, buyer_id, seller_id, last_message_at, last_preview, buyer_unread, seller_unread, created_at FROM conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT conversation_id, buyer_id, seller_id, last_message_at, last_preview, buyer_unread, seller_unread, created_at FROM conversation WHERE buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation WHERE buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId}

SELECT conversation_id, buyer_id, seller_id, last_message_at, last_preview, buyer_unread, seller_unread, CASE WHEN buyer_id = #{userId} THEN buyer_unread ELSE seller_unread END AS unread_count FROM conversation WHERE buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_message_at DESC, conversation_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
